{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, check for any non-numeric entries that might cause issues
print("\nInvalid revenue entries (not matching pattern):", data[~data['revenue'].str.match(r'^\d+,?\d*\.?\d*$')]['revenue'].unique())

# Clean: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify conversion
print("\nSample cleaned revenue:", data['revenue_clean'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print("\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", (data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
